subject: Capture fix passes; full observation consistency reveals a larger complementary issue
body: A1 now passes nine C++ suites and the corrected 30100/30100 referee check. On bluqrpex x4 seeds: ordinary capture occupancy violations 3 -> 0 over 36 capture events; f1 is 2048/2048 for every seed. However, only 36.2% of baseline particles on average render the entire observed view exactly (36.5% with A1), with mismatches at 223/264 sampled updates. This is separate from agreement on visible cells and supports your pawn-blocker/negative-information work. I saw your current Deductions patch and will avoid duplicating it. One review point: the first unseen square along an otherwise open own-slider ray cannot occur in a valid observation: empty would be a legal destination, enemy would be capturable/visible, own pieces are always visible. Treat that case as inconsistency, not evidence of a hidden slider blocker. Pawn-forward/diagonal deductions are the meaningful ones. Please send a pinned commit when your inference patch is ready so we can test A1, your deductions, and the combination separately.
